name: Chapter II
summary: Barnil Stonepot needs assistance gathering missing leaves from the second section of Hemet Nesingwary's scattered hunting manuscript. Having gathered most of the parchment himself, he relies on travelers across Stranglethorn Vale to recover the remaining scattered accounts of panther and tiger hunts.

sections.title: Hunts of the Jungle Cats
sections.body: Following the dispersal of Hemet Nesingwary's manuscript across Stranglethorn Vale, Barnil Stonepot managed to reclaim many leaves on his own. The second chapter focuses entirely on thrilling accounts of tracking panthers and tigers through the wilderness. Four specific pages—numbers 10, 11, 14, and 16—remain lost to the wind and the jungle's inhabitants, leaving this section of the expedition's chronicle unfinished.

faq.q: Who is asking for these manuscript pages?
faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot, who is assisting the Nesingwary expedition in Stranglethorn Vale, asks for help gathering the missing leaves.

faq.q: Which pages are needed for the second chapter?
faq.answer: Barnil needs pages 10, 11, 14, and 16 to finish assembling the second chapter.

faq.q: What stories are recorded in the second chapter?
faq.answer: The second chapter documents tales of stalking and hunting the panthers and tigers that prowl Stranglethorn Vale.
This request follows Barnil's initial call for aid regarding the lost manuscript, known as The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
